rating: No new calibration; last exact0.7.6-q-evasion estimate2319,local95%2277..2360 retained. Models do not inherit it.
limits: Relations are geometric and aggregate: no legal-capture or tactical oracle. More expensive inference may outweigh fit gains. Equal epochs are not equal compute. No promotion on fit/speed/tactics alone; all prior playing gates retained. Full Stockfish superiority and public Elo remain unestablished.
runtime_policy: Freeze new runtime/source after required checks, before training matches. All candidate/control/classical match roles use that exact runtime. Compare classical depth8 moves/scores/nodes and bench against the prior runtime; playing search/evaluation/rules stay unchanged except optional neural feature inference.

features.categories: absolute color White then Black, piece kind pawn/knight/bishop/rook/queen, status undefended then defended; 20 categories
features.semantics: Geometric opponent attack intersected with each piece bitboard; undefended excludes own geometric control, defended intersects own control. Both colors' maps include pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen and king attacks; sliders include the first occupied square. Pins count geometrically; this is not legal capture, SEE, a hanging-piece proof or zugzwang. No side-to-move or en-passant pseudo-target dependence.
features.encoding: Count each category and clip to0..3, where3 means3+. One-hot4bins per category. Perspective-relative color: own first, opponent second. Index13056+(((relativeColor*5+kind)*2+status)*4+bin). Twenty active features per perspective, including count0 bins.
features.formats: 11 hybrid and12 standalone, clipped phase/turn/king-context mandatory; formats1..10 preserved
features.incremental: Rebuild maps only when geometry changed; update categorical embeddings by removing prior bins and adding new bins. King-bucket rebuilds must restore relation embeddings even when counts stay unchanged. Null move preserves geometry; speculative make/undo without evaluation cancels deltas.
features.verification: Independent python-chess geometric maps vs native bitboards on broad legal positions, malformed model checks, exact nonzero quantized inference, make/eval/undo, null moves, king buckets, phase changes, castling, promotion, en-passant and pinned pieces.
